results.title: Melbourne's 'liveable city' reputation questioned after fatal stabbing - ABC News
results.snippet:
A delivery rider's death has renewed debate about safety in Melbourne.(ABC News: Jarrod Fankhauser)

A HungryPanda delivery rider's fatal stabbing sent shock waves beyond the local community, spreading across China through social media and state media coverage.

Reports of 47-year-old Chinese national Feng Jianming's death last Friday were amplified through WeChat groups and public accounts. [...]
